source: Federal Elections Analysis direct poll-release ledger
instructions: Add one object per public pollster release. Required: office, pollster, sourceUrl, endDate, dem, rep, plus state for Senate or district (for example IA-01) for House. Optional: sampleSize, population (lv, rv, or adults), sponsor, partisan, internal, source, weight. Rows are deduplicated against public aggregators by pollster and end date; campaign/internal and partisan polls are down-weighted.
